title: One of Godzilla’s Biggest Movies is Coming to Netflix This Summer
content: Godzilla has had a big year in 2026, with even more to come when the King of the Monsters returns to theaters this fall. Earlier in the year, Apple TV released the second season of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters , seeing the lizard king make a comeback to fight against the powerful Titan X.

title: Anomalith Survival Horror Game's Trailer Previews Story
content: FuRyu began streaming on Tuesday an English-subtitled trailer for ANOMALITH , an anomaly horror survival action game , and it previews the story: The company will release the game for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam on October 29.

title: 'Marriagetoxin' Gets Second Season in Winter 2027
content: The 13th and final episode of Marriagetoxin ended with an announcement on Tuesday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement promo. The second season is scheduled to premiere on Kansai TV and Fuji TV's new Karnival!! programming slot at 11:00 p.m. in January 2027.

title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game's Opening Movie Previews Aimer's Theme Song
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming on Tuesday the opening movie for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise , and it previews the theme song "Live to Survive" by Aimer .

title: Splatoon Raiders Game's Video Previews Enemies, Gadgets, Facilities, Outfits, Stages, Multiplayer
content: Nintendo streamed on Tuesday a Direct video for Splatoon Raiders , a new single-player spinoff game in its Splatoon series. The Direct previewed treasure hunting gameplay, enemies, gadgets, facilities, outfits, stages, and multiplayer.
